name: Computer Networks
summary: How the Internet works layer by layer, from applications and sockets through TCP, IP routing and link layers, with hands-on protocol analysis.

topics.name: Network architecture, layering and the Internet's design principles
Performance: delay, throughput and the bandwidth-delay product
Application layer: HTTP, DNS, email and peer-to-peer
Network layer: IP addressing, subnets, NAT and IPv6
Routing algorithms and protocols: link state, distance vector, OSPF and BGP
Link layer: Ethernet, switching, ARP and VLANs
Wireless and mobile networks: Wi-Fi and cellular basics
Network security basics: TLS, firewalls and VPNs
Content delivery networks and video streaming
Network tools: Wireshark, tcpdump and traceroute
